senses.def: An expression of mild disappointment or resignation: too bad; it's a pity; what can you do; it is what it is.
ex: I didn’t know the store closes at five on Thursdays. Oh well, I’ll have to come back tomorrow.

I just learned that slugs have teeth.
Oh worm?

senses.def: Yes; I understand or can relate.
ex:
I woke up today and I just don't feel like doing anything.
Oh worm. I know what you mean.
